discovery.title: California scientist wins a Nobel Prize, then makes school lunches for his kids
discovery.summary: Dr. Karl Deisseroth spent hours fielding congratulatory calls after learning early Monday that he had won a Nobel Prize for medicine for helping to open a new field of brain science called optogenetics.
